About this timeline

A curated history from The Blueprint. We select developments for their significance at the time: research, products, creative uses, infrastructure, scientific applications, industry changes and societal consequences.

This is a selected record, rather than a list of every announcement. Dates refer to the milestone described; source links provide context. Content updates and editorial corrections are reviewed before publication.
